approaches.mathematical_result: Proved alternating signs exist iff the side count is even and descend iff the cyclic shift is even; double-cover descent fails for sign-reversing deck action.

approaches.remaining_gap: No globally constructed cooriented knot-exterior lamination.

approaches.mathematical_result: Proved N=m|b| and shift m a for m parallel primitive (a,b) sutures; invariant alternation exists iff m is even. For 2k meridional sutures, N=2k|q| and shift 2k d.
approaches.remaining_gap: The meridional-cusped collar and interstitial extension must first be constructed.

approaches.mathematical_result: Constructed logarithmic graph foliations for even-rotation regular ideal polygon bundles; proved nonsingularity, integrability, disk leaves, side extension and interior transverse core.
approaches.remaining_gap: No theorem identifies every desired global complementary region with this marked analytic model or supplies all old-leaf transversals.

approaches.mathematical_result: Reconstructed the conditional route with tautness, tightness, source-sector, no-sink and noncompact-extension hypotheses; proved the exceptional slope must be the knot meridian.
approaches.remaining_gap: No construction meeting these hypotheses for an arbitrary alternating diagram is supplied.
